summary: Measure training impact, calculate ROI, and build learning analytics dashboards with practical tools, templates, and executive reporting.
lede: Training evaluation and learning analytics link learner data with job-performance and business measures to assess the value of learning. This course is for L&D managers, learning analysts, training coordinators and HR partners who need to justify learning spend and report outcomes; it covers setting baselines, calculating training costs and benefits, and interpreting LMS data. You will also practice designing KPI scorecards and dashboards and preparing reports for stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to measure training impact, justify learning spend, and report evidence-backed outcomes to decision-makers. L&D Managers responsible for training evaluation strategy and reporting. Learning Analysts tracking LMS data, completion trends, and skill metrics. Training Coordinators compiling evaluation data and learner feedback. HR Business Partners linking learning outcomes to workforce performance. Capability Managers aligning training metrics with role readiness. Talent Development Specialists building ROI evidence for leadership. Organizational Development Consultants diagnosing learning impact gaps. Performance Improvement Specialists connecting training to operational results. Instructional Designers embedding evaluation measures into program design. People Analytics Specialists integrating learning data with workforce dashboards.
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should already work with training, HR, L&D, or performance data in some form and be comfortable reading basic spreadsheets and charts. No coding is required, although prior exposure to LMS reports, survey data, or KPI reporting will help you move faster through the applied exercises. If your role involves measuring training impact, presenting learning results, or justifying L&D spend, you are ready for this course.
